system.description:
The sky belongs to you.

One per long rest, you launch and control drones that provide tactical overwatch. Spotlight an Action to shift the drones between Offensive mode and Defensive mode:

Defensive mode: You have +2 Evasion and all allies have +1 Evasion

Offensive mode: You have +2 to your attacks and all allies have +1 to their attacks
